Synthetic ENAHO Household Sample for FIES and Rasch Training

Source: R/data.R
fies_sample.Rd

A lightweight synthetic dataset of 400 stratified households mimicking the structure and item severity ordering of the Peruvian ENAHO Module 2082 (`enaho01-<year>-130`, Chapter 130) and Module 34 (`sumaria-<year>-12g`). Designed both for offline package examples/tests and as a hands-on training dataset for teaching Food Insecurity Experience Scale ('FIES') and Rasch psychometric analysis.

Usage

fies_sample

Format

A data frame with 400 rows and 23 columns:

year

Survey year (`2025`).

conglome

Primary sampling unit identifier.

vivienda

Dwelling identifier.

hogar

Household identifier.

ubigeo

Six-digit geographic code.

dominio

Geographic domain (`1`–`8`).

estrato

Sampling stratum (`1`–`8`, where `6`–`8` are rural).

factor07

Household annual sampling weight.

mieperho

Number of household members.

pobreza

Monetary poverty code (`1` = Extreme poor, `2` = Non-extreme poor, `3` = Non-poor).

pobrezav

Vulnerability code (`1`–`4`).

gashog2d

Annual gross household expenditure (PEN).

inghog2d

Annual net household income (PEN).

p130_1

`WORRIED`: Worried about not having enough food (`1` = Yes, `2` = No).

p130_2

`HEALTHY`: Unable to eat healthy and nutritious food (`1` = Yes, `2` = No).

p130_3

`FEWFOOD`: Ate only a few kinds of foods (`1` = Yes, `2` = No).

p130_4

`SKIPPED`: Had to skip a meal (`1` = Yes, `2` = No).

p130_5

`ATELESS`: Ate less than normal (`1` = Yes, `2` = No; global threshold for Moderate or Severe).

p130_6

`RUNOUT`: Household ran out of food (`1` = Yes, `2` = No).

p130_7

`HUNGRY`: Felt hungry but did not eat (`1` = Yes, `2` = No).

p130_8

`WHLDAY`: Went without eating for a whole day (`1` = Yes, `2` = No; global threshold for Severe).

has_child_u5

Indicator (`0`/`1`) for presence of children under 5 years.

has_disability

Indicator (`0`/`1`) for presence of a member with permanent disability.

Source

Simulated Rasch item responses calibrated to the FAO FIES global scale.

See also

[fies_items()] for the verbatim Spanish and English wording of all eight items.
